acceptance_gate_results.principle: Every frozen floor boundary must match.
Malformed and contradictory declarations must remain strict.
The unchanged positive and negative assertions must pass on authenticated private bytes.
Both public readers must expose the same class floor.
Only the requested focused validation may determine readiness.

field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: Declare models executable in this invocation; keep historical model metadata in hashed sidecars.
field_principles.acceptance_gate_results: Each criterion retains expected, observed, passed and principle; completion is separate from value.
field_principles.boundary_rows: Below/at-floor pairs and contradiction controls detect an overbroad relaxation.
field_principles.compute_contract_ready_score: One requires the corrected shared floor and the original pre-test behavior to be exercised cleanly.
field_principles.duration_s: Measure monotonic invocation time and disjoint phase spans; do not invent elapsed time.
field_principles.execution_venue: Use host for host orchestration; identify real boards separately in board rows.
field_principles.field_principles: Store explanations here; consumers read ordinary top-level values, not nested wrappers.
field_principles.fixture_repair_receipt: Record failing old dependency, replacement fixture hashes and preserved assertions.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: For blocked_* name the upstream, exact field/check, observed value and expected value.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Use complete_* for terminal measurements, blocked_* for external absence, and explain the finding.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Use an existing recognized literal that describes actual computation.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: Declare actual compute: full generation 60s, bounded generation 10s, load-only 2s; never pad time.
field_principles.invocation_counts: Separate attempted/completed loads and generation calls from usable answers.
field_principles.model_invoked: Derive from actual calls; a parse failure does not erase a model invocation.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Retain observed input hashes, resource ownership and failures before expensive work.
field_principles.random_seed: Freeze independent-unit seeds before inspecting outcomes.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Bind code, input manifests, configuration and raw evidence to the result.
field_principles.rows: Retain each independent unit, arm, seed, metric, error, abstention and censoring state for recomputation.
field_principles.run_date: Use 20260913, with actual UTC start/end timestamps, so dated evidence is auditable.
field_principles.sample_size_budget: Record planned, attempted, completed and censored units and the fixed stopping rule.
field_principles.schema: Version the result; retain ordinary top-level experiment_id and milestone.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Authenticate exact inputs and preserve quarantine and retirement state.
field_principles.status: Use complete or blocked only for terminal work; unfinished work stays in a separate checkpoint.
field_principles.validation_receipts: Record actual command, exit code and log hash; preserve failures and never suppress checks.
field_principles.verdict_class: Exactly positive | circular_positive | null | blocked | disqualified | partial. Oracle=true forbids positive; failed scientific gates forbid positive. Only incomplete own work is partial; unchanged external blocks are blocked.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Expose shared evaluator/verifier authority; exact conformance is not learned correctness.

failing_observed_input.observed_value: missing|{id: null, milestone: null, deliverable: null}

sample_size_budget.stopping_rule: Evaluate every frozen fixture exactly once; do not stop on outcome.
